EA-15841.name: Exp_Volume_Weighted_MA
EA-15841.summary: This EA trades based on the Volume Weighted Moving Average indicator, generating buy signals when the VWMA turns upward and sell signals when it turns downward. It compares three consecutive VWMA values to detect trend direction changes and uses configurable money management modes for position sizing. Entries and exits are controlled separately with boolean toggles, and StopLoss/TakeProfit levels are applied to all positions.
EA-15841.summary_zh: 该EA基于成交量加权移动平均线(VWMA)指标进行交易，当VWMA拐头向上时产生买入信号，拐头向下时产生卖出信号。通过比较三个连续的VWMA值来检测趋势方向变化，并使用可配置的资金管理模式进行仓位管理。入场和出场分别通过布尔开关独立控制，所有仓位均设置止损和止盈。
EA-15841.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于成交量加权移动平均线(VWMA)的趋势跟踪，利用成交量对价格的加权来确认趋势的真实性。入场条件为：当Value[1]<Value[2]（VWMA从下降转为上升）且Value[0]>Value[1]（当前值继续上升）时开多单；当Value[1]>Value[2]（VWMA从上升转为下降）且Value[0]<Value[1]时开空单。出场条件为：趋势反转时分别平仓——VWMA下降时平多单，VWMA上升时平空单，同时设置固定点数的止损(1000点)和止盈(2000点)。仓位管理支持多种模式，包括按可用保证金比例、按余额比例、按扣除浮亏后的保证金/余额比例，以及固定手数模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例（默认0.1），配合MMMode选择具体的计算方式。策略使用了新K线检测机制（IsNewBar），避免在同一根K线内重复开仓，同时也支持在SignalBar为0时每个tick都进行信号计算。
EA-15841.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is trend following based on the Volume Weighted Moving Average (VWMA), which uses volume weighting to confirm the authenticity of price trends. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when Value[1]<Value[2] (VWMA turns from declining to rising) and Value[0]>Value[1] (current value continues rising); a sell signal is generated when Value[1]>Value[2] (VWMA turns from rising to declining) and Value[0]<Value[1]. Exit conditions: positions are closed on trend reversal — long positions close when VWMA declines, short positions close when VWMA rises, with fixed StopLoss (1000 points) and TakeProfit (2000 points) applied. Position sizing supports multiple modes including percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of margin/balance minus floating loss, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter (default 0.1 risk ratio) combined with the MMMode selector for the specific calculation method. The strategy employs a new bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) to prevent repeated entries within the same bar, while also supporting per-tick signal calculation when SignalBar is set to 0.

EA-15848.name: cm Universal Trailing Stop Hedge
EA-15848.summary: This is a universal trailing stop utility for MetaTrader 5 that manages existing positions using seven different trailing algorithms: fixed points, fractals, ATR, Parabolic SAR, Moving Average, percentage of profit, and fixed pips. It supports both real SL modification and virtual trailing stop that closes positions when price hits the computed level, and provides visual chart labels and arrows for no-loss levels and stop levels.
EA-15848.summary_zh: 这是一个MetaTrader 5通用追踪止损工具，使用七种不同算法（固定点数、分形、ATR、抛物线SAR、均线、利润百分比、固定点）管理已有持仓的止损。支持真实止损修改和虚拟追踪止损（价格触及计算水平时平仓），并在图表上显示无亏损水平和止损水平的标签与箭头。
EA-15848.strategy_analysis: 此EA是一个纯工具型程序，不自行开仓，仅对已有持仓进行止损管理。策略概念是基于七种可选算法动态调整止损水平：1）按K线极值（最低价/最高价）加减偏移量设置止损；2）按分形结构（比尔·威廉姆斯分形）加减偏移量设置止损；3）按ATR指标值从当前价格回撤设置止损；4）按抛物线SAR指标值加减偏移量设置止损；5）按移动均线值加减偏移量设置止损；6）按利润百分比值设置止损；7）按固定点数从当前价格回撤设置止损。入场条件：无，EA不负责入场，仅管理已有持仓。出场条件：当价格触及追踪止损水平时平仓（虚拟模式）或修改SL至追踪水平（普通模式）。仓位管理：支持按魔术号筛选持仓，虚拟追踪止损模式下按整体多空加权均价计算止损水平。资金管理：无独立资金管理逻辑，止损追踪距离由参数delta、StepTrall、StartTrall控制。
EA-15848.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is a pure utility that does not open its own positions; it only manages stop loss levels for existing positions. The strategy concept is based on seven selectable algorithms for dynamically adjusting stop loss levels: 1) by candle extremes (low/high) plus a delta offset; 2) by Bill Williams fractal structures plus delta; 3) by ATR indicator value retraced from current price; 4) by Parabolic SAR value plus delta; 5) by Moving Average value plus delta; 6) by a percentage of current profit; 7) by a fixed pip distance from current price. Entry conditions: none — the EA does not handle entries, it only manages existing positions. Exit conditions: when price hits the trailing stop level, positions are closed (virtual mode) or SL is modified to the trailing level (normal mode). Position management: supports filtering positions by magic number; in virtual trailing mode, it calculates the weighted average price (no-loss level) for all buy and sell positions separately. Money management: no independent money management logic; trailing distance is controlled by the delta, StepTrall, and StartTrall parameters.

pros: 提供七种不同的追踪止损算法，灵活性极高，适合各种交易风格
虚拟追踪止损模式可在经纪商限制SL修改时使用，且按加权均价计算整体仓位止损
提供丰富的图表视觉反馈（止损水平线、箭头、标签），方便实时监控止损状态
支持按魔术号筛选持仓，可与其他EA配合使用而不冲突
pros_en: Offers seven different trailing stop algorithms, providing extremely high flexibility for various trading styles
Virtual trailing stop mode works when brokers restrict SL modification, and calculates overall position stop based on weighted average price
Provides rich visual chart feedback (stop level lines, arrows, labels) for real-time monitoring of stop loss status
Supports position filtering by magic number, allowing conflict-free coexistence with other EAs
cons: 代码中存在严重BUG：第125行使用OrderGetInteger(ORDER_MAGIC)获取魔术号，但遍历的是持仓而非订单，应使用PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)
枚举变量名（b,c,d,e,f,g,i）极不语义化，可读性极差，维护困难
StrPer函数中多个时间周期映射错误（如H3映射为M3、H4映射为M4等）
虚拟追踪止损模式下缺少止损水平的STOPS_LEVEL校验，可能在实际交易中产生问题
SlLastBar函数中K线极值搜索循环（500根K线）效率低且无边界保护
cons_en: Critical bug on line 125: uses OrderGetInteger(ORDER_MAGIC) while iterating positions, should use PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) — this causes magic number filtering to fail entirely
Enum variable names (b,c,d,e,f,g,i) are extremely non-semantic, making the code nearly unreadable and hard to maintain
StrPer function has multiple timeframe mapping errors (e.g. H3 maps to M3, H4 maps to M4, etc.)
Virtual trailing stop mode lacks STOPS_LEVEL validation for the computed stop level, which may cause issues in live trading
The candle extreme search loop (500 bars) in SlLastBar is inefficient and lacks boundary protection
improvements: 修复魔术号获取BUG：将OrderGetInteger(ORDER_MAGIC)改为PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC)，此为关键性错误
将枚举变量名从单字母改为语义化名称（如FIXED_POINTS、FRACTAL、ATR、PARABOLIC、MA、PERCENT_PROFIT、PIP_FIXED）
添加新K线检测逻辑，避免每个tick都执行所有计算和止损修改，减少资源消耗和交易服务器负担
修复StrPer函数中的时间周期映射错误，并添加对H3、H4、H6、H8、H12等时间周期的正确映射
improvements_en: Fix the magic number retrieval bug: change OrderGetInteger(ORDER_MAGIC) to PositionGetInteger(POSITION_MAGIC) — this is a critical error that breaks magic number filtering
Rename enum values from single letters to semantic names (e.g. FIXED_POINTS, FRACTAL, ATR, PARABOLIC, MA, PERCENT_PROFIT, PIP_FIXED)
Add new bar detection logic to avoid executing all calculations and SL modifications on every tick, reducing resource consumption and trading server load
Fix the timeframe mapping errors in StrPer function and add correct mappings for H3, H4, H6, H8, H12 timeframes

risk_points: 魔术号筛选BUG导致所有持仓被管理而非仅指定魔术号的持仓，可能意外修改其他EA的止损
虚拟追踪止损模式下缺少订单发送前的OrderCheck校验（买入侧），可能导致无效订单请求
无新K线检测机制，每个tick都尝试修改止损，在高频行情下可能触发经纪商限制或被判定为滥用
止损水平未考虑点差和STOPS_LEVEL限制，虚拟模式可能在不利条件下平仓
risk_points_en: Magic number filtering bug causes all positions to be managed instead of only those with the specified magic number, potentially modifying other EAs' stop losses unintentionally
Virtual trailing stop mode lacks OrderCheck validation on the buy side before sending orders, which may result in invalid order requests
No new bar detection mechanism — every tick attempts SL modification, which may trigger broker restrictions or be flagged as abuse under high-frequency market conditions
Stop loss levels do not account for spread and STOPS_LEVEL limitations, and virtual mode may close positions under unfavorable conditions

EA-15849.name: Timer Trade
EA-15849.summary: This EA places alternating Buy and Sell orders on a fixed timer interval, creating a hedging position system. Each trade includes a Stop Loss and Take Profit, and the direction alternates between buy and sell on each timer trigger.
EA-15849.summary_zh: 该EA按固定时间间隔交替下买单和卖单，形成对冲持仓系统。每笔交易设有止损和止盈，每次定时器触发时交易方向在买入和卖出之间交替切换。
EA-15849.strategy_analysis: 策略概念是基于定时器的时间驱动交易，每隔设定秒数自动开仓，交替执行买入和卖出操作，形成对冲持仓。入场条件完全依赖时间触发，无任何技术指标或价格分析，定时器到期即开仓。出场条件依赖固定的止损和止盈点数，止损较小（10点）而止盈较大（50点），风险收益比为1:5。仓位管理使用固定手数（TradeValue参数），没有根据账户资金或波动率进行动态调整。资金管理完全缺失，没有检查账户余额、已持仓数量或最大持仓限制，可能导致无限累积对冲仓位。
EA-15849.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is purely time-driven trading based on a timer, automatically opening positions at fixed intervals with alternating buy and sell directions to create a hedging layout. Entry conditions rely entirely on the timer event with no technical indicators or price analysis — a trade is placed every time the timer fires. Exit conditions depend on fixed Stop Loss (10 points) and Take Profit (50 points) levels, giving a risk-reward ratio of 1:5. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size (TradeValue parameter) with no dynamic adjustment based on account equity or market volatility. Money management is completely absent — there is no check on account balance, existing position count, or maximum position limits, which could lead to unlimited accumulation of hedged positions.
pros: 策略逻辑简单直观，易于理解和部署
止损止盈比例1:5，单笔交易风险收益比较好
交替买卖形成自然对冲，一定程度上降低了单边风险
使用CTrade标准库，代码简洁规范
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and intuitive, easy to understand and deploy
Stop Loss to Take Profit ratio of 1:5 provides a favorable risk-reward per trade
Alternating buy/sell creates natural hedging, partially reducing directional risk
Uses the standard CTrade library for clean and conventional order execution
cons: 完全没有技术分析，入场纯粹依赖时间，无视市场状态
没有持仓数量检查，定时器持续触发会导致仓位无限累积
止损仅10点过于紧密，极易被市场噪音触发止损
没有检查新柱或交易时段过滤，可能在低流动性时段开仓
Bug：EventSetTimer参数使用TimerTime*100，实际间隔远超预期值
cons_en: No technical analysis whatsoever — entries are purely time-based, ignoring market conditions entirely
No position count check — the timer continuously firing leads to unlimited position accumulation
Stop Loss of only 10 points is extremely tight and easily triggered by market noise
No new bar check or trading session filter — may open positions during low liquidity periods
Bug: EventSetTimer uses TimerTime*100, making actual interval far longer than the intended value
improvements: 增加最大持仓数量限制和账户资金检查，防止仓位无限累积
添加技术指标作为入场过滤条件，避免在不利市场环境下开仓
修正EventSetTimer的参数错误，应为TimerTime而非TimerTime*100
增加交易时段过滤和点差检查，避免在不利条件下交易
improvements_en: Add maximum position count limit and account equity check to prevent unlimited position accumulation
Add technical indicators as entry filters to avoid trading in unfavorable market conditions
Fix the EventSetTimer parameter bug — should be TimerTime instead of TimerTime*100
Add trading session filter and spread check to avoid trading under adverse conditions

risk_points: 没有持仓数量上限检查，定时器持续触发会导致无限开仓累积巨大风险
止损10点过小极易被触发导致频繁亏损
EventSetTimer参数Bug导致实际交易间隔与预期严重不符

EA-15852.name: Exp_Volume_Weighted_MA_StDev
EA-15852.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the Volume Weighted MA with Standard Deviation channels indicator. It opens buy positions when the VWMA turns upward or when buy signal dots appear, and sell positions on downward turns or sell dots. Position sizing supports multiple margin modes and standard stop-loss/take-profit controls are provided.
EA-15852.summary_zh: 该EA基于成交量加权均线及标准差通道指标的信号进行交易。当VWMA向上转折或出现买入信号点时开多仓，向下转折或出现卖出信号点时开空仓。支持多种保证金模式和止损止盈控制。
EA-15852.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是成交量加权移动平均线（VWMA）结合标准差通道，利用成交量对价格的加权来识别趋势方向。入场条件支持三种模式：POINT模式通过指标缓冲区2-5的信号点（非EMPTY_VALUE）触发交易；DIRECT模式通过VWMA线的转折判断（买入需当前值大于前值且前值小于更前值，卖出反之）；WITHOUT模式则禁用对应信号。出场条件同样支持三种模式，买入平仓可由卖出信号点或VWMA线下降触发，卖出平仓反之。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制，支持固定手数、按余额比例、按可用保证金比例等多种模式。资金管理依托TradeAlgorithms.mqh库的BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen等函数实现。策略使用多系数dK1和dK2控制标准差通道的宽度，配合std_period计算标准差周期，以识别价格偏离均线的程度。
EA-15852.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy centers on a Volume Weighted Moving Average (VWMA) combined with Standard Deviation channels, using volume weighting to better identify true trend direction. Entry conditions support three modes: POINT mode triggers trades when signal dots appear in indicator buffers 2-5 (non-EMPTY_VALUE); DIRECT mode detects VWMA line turns (buy when current > previous and previous < the one before, sell on the opposite); WITHOUT mode disables the corresponding signal entirely. Exit conditions mirror the entry modes — buy positions close on sell signal dots or VWMA decline, and sell positions close on buy signal dots or VWMA rise. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting fixed lot size, balance-proportional sizing, and free margin-proportional sizing among other modes. Money management relies on the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) for execution. The strategy uses coefficients dK1 and dK2 to scale the Standard Deviation channel width, with std_period defining the lookback for deviation calculation, identifying how far price has deviated from the weighted mean.

EA-15873.name: Exp_Fisher_org_v1
EA-15873.summary: This EA trades based on the Fisher_org_v1 custom indicator, which produces a main line and a signal line. It opens buy positions when the main line crosses above the signal line and sell positions when it crosses below, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options.
EA-15873.summary_zh: 该EA基于Fisher_org_v1自定义指标进行交易，该指标生成主线和信号线。当主线从下方穿越信号线时开多仓，当主线从上方穿越信号线时开空仓，支持可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理方式。
EA-15873.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用Fisher_org_v1指标的双线交叉策略，主线(Ind)和信号线(Sign)的交叉作为交易信号。入场条件：当主线大于信号线且前一根K线主线小于等于信号线时，产生买入信号；当主线小于信号线且前一根K线主线大于等于信号线时，产生卖出信号。出场条件通过反向交叉信号触发平仓，同时设有固定点数的止损(1000点)和止盈(2000点)。仓位管理采用多种模式，包括按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后余额比例、按亏损后自由保证金比例以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制比例，MMMode参数选择计算方式。EA还使用了IsNewBar机制确保每个K线周期只计算一次信号，避免重复交易，同时利用LoadHistory函数确保历史数据加载完整。
EA-15873.strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a dual-line crossover strategy using the Fisher_org_v1 indicator, where crossovers between the main line (Ind) and signal line (Sign) generate trading signals. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when the main line is above the signal line and the previous bar's main line was at or below the signal line; a sell signal triggers when the main line is below the signal line and the previous bar's main line was at or above the signal line. Exit conditions are triggered by reverse crossover signals for position closure, complemented by fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) settings. Position sizing supports multiple modes including percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage after loss, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter for the proportion and the MMMode parameter for the calculation method. The EA also uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar period, preventing duplicate trades, and utilizes the LoadHistory function to ensure complete historical data loading.

EA-15887.name: Exp_Fisher_org_v1_Sign
EA-15887.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the Fisher_org_v1_Sign custom indicator, which uses a Fisher Transform with ATR normalization to identify momentum-based buy and sell signals. It opens buy positions on upward signals and sell positions on downward signals, with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels, and supports multiple money management modes including lot-based and percentage-based sizing.
EA-15887.summary_zh: 该EA基于Fisher_org_v1_Sign自定义指标的交易信号进行操作，该指标使用Fisher变换结合ATR归一化来识别动量买卖信号。在上升信号时开多仓，下降信号时开空仓，支持可配置的止损止盈水平，并提供包括固定手数和百分比在内的多种资金管理模式。
EA-15887.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于Fisher变换指标的动量信号，Fisher变换将价格数据转换为近似正态分布，从而更清晰地识别价格拐点。入场条件为：当指标上轨（UpValue）在指定信号K线上产生非零且非空值时开多仓，当指标下轨（DnValue）产生非零且非空值时开空仓。出场条件包括：固定点数的止损和止盈（默认1000点止损和2000点止盈），以及反向信号触发的平仓——当持有多仓时出现下轨信号则平多仓，持有空仓时出现上轨信号则平空仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：基于可用保证金、余额、亏损后可用保证金、亏损后余额和固定手数。EA还实现了新K栏检测机制以避免重复交易，并在反向信号未触发平仓时会回溯历史K栏寻找之前的平仓信号，这是一个相对独特的逻辑设计。
EA-15887.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on momentum signals from the Fisher Transform indicator, which converts price data into an approximately normal distribution to more clearly identify price turning points. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the indicator's upper buffer (UpValue) produces a non-zero, non-empty value on the specified signal bar, and a sell position is opened when the lower buffer (DnValue) produces a non-zero, non-empty value. Exit conditions include fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels (default 1000 points SL and 2000 points TP), plus reverse-signal-based closing — closing longs when a lower buffer signal appears and closing shorts when an upper buffer signal appears. Position sizing supports five modes: free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. The EA implements a new bar detection mechanism to avoid duplicate trades, and when a reverse signal hasn't triggered a close, it retrospectively scans historical bars to find prior closing signals, which is a relatively unique logic design.

EA-15888.name: Exp_JFatl_Digit_System
EA-15888.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom JFatl_Digit_System indicator, which combines a JMA-based digital filter with digit-level rounding. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend and sell positions on a downtrend, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options.
EA-15888.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义指标JFatl_Digit_System的信号进行交易，该指标结合了JMA平滑和数字滤波器。指标发出上升趋势信号时开多仓，下降趋势信号时开空仓，支持配置止损、止盈和资金管理方式。
EA-15888.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用JFatl_Digit_System自定义指标作为核心信号源，该指标基于JMA（Jurik Moving Average）平滑算法并叠加数字滤波器来识别趋势方向。入场条件：当指标颜色缓冲区（buffer 6）的值大于2且另一缓冲区值小于3时，产生买入信号开多仓；当颜色缓冲区值小于2且另一缓冲区值大于1时，产生卖出信号开空仓。出场条件：买入信号触发时同时平卖仓，卖出信号触发时同时平买仓，实现了趋势反转时的反向平仓逻辑。仓位管理支持五种模式：固定手数、基于余额百分比、基于净值百分比、基于可用保证金百分比和基于亏损后保证金百分比。资金管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制每笔交易的风险比例，止损和止盈分别默认设为1000和2000点。EA在新K线形成时才计算信号（IsNewBar机制），避免逐tick重复计算，但SignalBar为0时会在每个tick计算。
EA-15888.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the JFatl_Digit_System custom indicator as its core signal source, which is based on the JMA (Jurik Moving Average) smoothing algorithm combined with a digital filter to identify trend direction. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the indicator's color buffer (buffer 6) value exceeds 2 and another buffer value is below 3, opening a long position; a sell signal triggers when the color buffer value falls below 2 and the other buffer value exceeds 1, opening a short position. Exit conditions: when a buy signal fires, existing sell positions are simultaneously closed, and vice versa, implementing a trend-reversal exit logic. Position sizing supports five modes: fixed lot, balance-based percentage, equity-based percentage, free margin percentage, and loss-adjusted margin percentage. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration to regulate risk per trade, with default stop loss and take profit set at 1000 and 2000 points respectively. The EA only recalculates signals on new bar formation (IsNewBar mechanism) to avoid per-tick redundant computation, though it processes every tick when SignalBar is set to 0.

EA-15889.name: Exp_Volume_Weighted_MA_Digit_System
EA-15889.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the Volume_Weighted_MA_Digit_System custom indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator shows bullish signals (column value >2 and color <3) and sell positions when it shows bearish signals (column value <2 and color >1). It includes configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options with separate controls for opening and closing positions.
EA-15889.summary_zh: 该EA基于Volume_Weighted_MA_Digit_System自定义指标的交易信号进行操作，当指标显示看涨信号时开多仓，显示看跌信号时开空仓。它包含可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理选项，并分别控制开仓和平仓操作。
EA-15889.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于成交量加权移动平均线的数字化系统，通过自定义指标Volume_Weighted_MA_Digit_System生成买卖信号。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区6的第1根K线值大于2且颜色值小于3时，开启买入信号；当该值小于2且颜色值大于1时，开启卖出信号。出场条件通过独立的布尔开关控制，买入平仓在卖出信号触发时执行，卖出平仓在买入信号触发时执行。仓位管理支持五种模式：自由保证金、余额、亏损后自由保证金、亏损后余额和固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1手，止损1000点、止盈2000点。策略在每根新K线形成时计算信号，避免重复交易，同时通过IsNewBar机制确保信号只在新的价格柱上生成。
EA-15889.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a volume-weighted moving average digitized system that generates buy and sell signals through the custom Volume_Weighted_MA_Digit_System indicator. Entry conditions are: when indicator buffer 6's value at bar 1 exceeds 2 and its color value is below 3, a buy signal is triggered; when the value drops below 2 and the color exceeds 1, a sell signal is triggered. Exit conditions are controlled by separate boolean switches where buy positions close when sell signals appear and sell positions close when buy signals appear. Position sizing supports five modes: free margin, balance, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter with a default of 0.1 lots, a stop loss of 1000 points, and a take profit of 2000 points. The strategy recalculates signals only on new bar formation to avoid repetitive trades, using the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are generated only on new price bars.

EA-15890.name: Trade panel with autopilot
EA-15890.summary: A semi-automated trade panel EA that calculates buy/sell signal strength across 21 timeframes by comparing the current and previous bar's OHLC prices. It can either let the user manually trade via panel buttons or auto-trade when the aggregated signal percentage exceeds a configurable threshold, with optional fractal-based stop loss placement.
EA-15890.summary_zh: 一个半自动交易面板EA，通过比较当前和前一K线的OHLC价格在21个时间周期上计算买卖信号强度。用户可通过面板按钮手动交易，也可在聚合信号百分比超过可配置阈值时自动开仓，并支持基于分形的止损设置。
EA-15890.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于多周期价格比较信号：对每个时间周期，比较当前K线与前一根K线的开盘价、最高价、最低价、收盘价及其组合均值（共7项比较），统计看涨和看跌信号的数量。入场条件为：当所有时间周期的买入信号百分比超过开仓阈值（默认85%）时自动买入，卖出信号同理。出场条件为：当持仓方向的信号百分比低于平仓阈值（默认55%）时自动平仓。仓位管理支持固定手数或按净值百分比动态计算手数，最小手数为0.01。资金管理方面，当启用止损功能时，使用分形指标寻找最近的分形低点（多单）或分形高点（空单）作为止损位。策略未考虑点差、滑点和市场波动性过滤，存在在低流动性环境下频繁开平仓的风险。
EA-15890.strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is based on multi-timeframe price comparison signals: for each timeframe, it compares the current bar's Open, High, Low, Close and their composite averages against the previous bar's values (7 comparisons total), tallying bullish and bearish votes. Entry conditions: when the aggregated buy signal percentage across all timeframes exceeds the opening threshold (default 85%), it auto-opens a buy position; sell signals work symmetrically. Exit conditions: when the signal percentage for the held position's direction falls below the closing threshold (default 55%), it auto-closes the position. Position sizing supports either a fixed lot or a dynamic lot calculated as a percentage of account equity, with a minimum of 0.01 lots. Money management includes optional fractal-based stop loss placement: for buy positions, the nearest lower fractal below current price is used as SL; for sell positions, the nearest upper fractal above current price is used. The strategy does not account for spread, slippage, or volatility filtering, risking frequent open/close cycles in low-liquidity environments.

EA-15899.name: Exp_Volume_Weighted_MACandle
EA-15899.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom Volume Weighted MACandle indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator transitions to bullish (color=2) and sell positions when it transitions to bearish (color=0). It uses fixed stop loss and take profit levels with configurable money management and allows independent control of entry and exit directions.
EA-15899.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义的成交量加权MA蜡烛指标信号进行交易，当指标转为看涨颜色(2)时开多仓，转为看跌颜色(0)时开空仓。使用固定止损止损和止盈水平，支持可配置的资金管理方式，并可独立控制买入和卖出方向的入场与出场。
EA-15899.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于成交量加权移动平均线蜡烛指标，通过识别指标颜色的变化来判断市场动量方向。入场条件为：当指标当前颜色为2（看涨）且前一颜色小于2时开多仓，当指标当前颜色为0（看跌）且前一颜色大于0时开空仓。出场条件为：当指标转为看跌时平多仓，当指标转为看涨时平空仓，同时也设置了固定点数的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点）。仓位管理使用MM参数控制仓位大小，支持固定手数或基于保证金比例的两种模式（LOT和FREEMARGIN）。资金管理通过MarginMode枚举选择固定手数或自由保证金比例模式，但缺少加仓、减仓或追踪止损等动态仓位调整机制。整体策略逻辑清晰，但完全依赖单一指标信号，缺乏多维度确认和动态风险管理。
EA-15899.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a Volume Weighted Moving Average Candle indicator that identifies market momentum direction through color transitions. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the indicator's current color is 2 (bullish) and the previous color was less than 2, while a sell position opens when the current color is 0 (bearish) and the previous color was greater than 0. Exit conditions: long positions close when the indicator turns bearish, and short positions close when it turns bullish, with fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) as additional exit mechanisms. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, supporting either fixed lot size or margin-based percentage mode via the MarginMode enum (LOT vs FREEMARGIN). Money management offers two modes but lacks dynamic position adjustment mechanisms such as scaling in/out, trailing stops, or volatility-based sizing. The overall strategy logic is clear but relies entirely on a single indicator signal without multi-dimensional confirmation or dynamic risk management.

EA-15900.name: Exp_Donchian_Channels_System
EA-15900.summary: This EA trades Donchian Channel breakouts by reading signals from a custom Donchian Channels System indicator. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an upward breakout and sell positions on downward breakouts, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and money management options.
EA-15900.summary_zh: 该EA基于唐奇安通道突破策略，通过读取自定义唐奇安通道系统指标的信号进行交易。当指标发出向上突破信号时开多仓，向下突破时开空仓，并提供可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理选项。
EA-15900.strategy_analysis: 该EA采用经典的唐奇安通道突破策略，价格突破通道上轨时做多，突破下轨时做空。入场条件由自定义指标Donchian_Channels_System的8号缓冲区决定：当Col[1]>2且Col[0]<3时触发买入信号，当Col[1]<2且Col[0]>1时触发卖出信号。出场条件包括反向信号平仓和固定止损/止盈，止损1000点、止盈2000点，盈亏比2:1。仓位管理支持五种模式：按可用保证金比例、按余额比例、按扣除浮亏后的可用保证金比例、按扣除浮亏后的余额比例、固定手数。EA使用新K线检测机制避免重复信号，并在每根新K线时重新计算交易信号，确保不会在同一根K线上重复开仓。
EA-15900.strategy_analysis_en: This EA implements the classic Donchian Channel breakout strategy, going long when price breaks above the upper channel and short when it breaks below the lower channel. Entry conditions are determined by the custom Donchian_Channels_System indicator's buffer 8: a buy signal triggers when Col[1]>2 and Col[0]<3, while a sell signal triggers when Col[1]<2 and Col[0]>1. Exit conditions include closing positions on reverse signals and using fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points), yielding a risk-reward ratio of 2:1. Position sizing supports five money management modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin minus floating loss, percentage of balance minus floating loss, and fixed lot size. The EA employs a new bar detection mechanism to avoid duplicate signals, recalculating trade signals only on each new bar to prevent repeated entries on the same candle.

EA-15950.name: Exp_AroonOscillatorSignAlert
EA-15950.summary: This EA trades based on the Aroon Oscillator indicator with alert signals. It opens buy positions on upward crossover signals and sell positions on downward crossover signals, with configurable stop-loss, take-profit, and money management options.
EA-15950.summary_zh: 该EA基于Aroon振荡器指标的信号进行交易。在向上穿越信号时开多仓，在向下穿越信号时开空仓，并支持可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理选项。
EA-15950.strategy_analysis: 该EA使用Aroon振荡器指标（AroonOscillatorSignAlert自定义指标）作为核心交易信号源。入场条件为：当指标上轨缓冲区（buffer 1）在设定信号K线上产生非零且非空值时，触发买入开仓和卖出平仓信号；当指标下轨缓冲区（buffer 0）产生有效信号时，触发卖出开仓和买入平仓信号。出场条件依赖固定的止损和止盈设置，同时也支持反向信号平仓——当同时启用买入和卖出开平仓时，EA会回溯历史K线寻找反向信号来决定是否平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举支持五种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按净自由保证金比例、按净余额比例和固定手数。资金管理采用固定止损止盈点数方式，无动态调整机制，缺乏根据市场波动性自适应调整止损止盈的能力。整体策略属于典型的动量跟随系统，依赖Aroon振荡器穿越阈值水平来判断趋势动量变化。
EA-15950.strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the Aroon Oscillator indicator (custom AroonOscillatorSignAlert indicator) as its core signal source. Entry conditions: when the indicator's upper buffer (buffer 1) produces a non-zero, non-empty value on the configured signal bar, it triggers a buy open and sell close signal; when the lower buffer (buffer 0) produces a valid signal, it triggers a sell open and buy close signal. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop-loss and take-profit settings, and also support reverse-signal closing — when both buy and sell open/close are enabled, the EA retrospects historical bars to find opposing signals to determine whether to close positions. Position sizing supports five modes via the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration: by free margin percentage, by balance percentage, by net free margin percentage, by net balance percentage, and fixed lot size. Money management uses fixed stop-loss and take-profit in points with no dynamic adjustment mechanism, lacking the ability to adapt stops and targets based on market volatility. The overall strategy is a typical momentum-following system relying on the Aroon Oscillator crossing threshold levels to detect trend momentum changes.

EA-15979.name: Exp_i-CAi
EA-15979.summary: This EA trades based on the custom i-CAi indicator, which is a smoothed moving average crossover system. It opens buy positions when the indicator values turn upward and sell positions when they turn downward, with configurable position sizing and stop loss/take profit levels.
EA-15979.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义i-CAi指标进行交易，i-CAi是一个平滑移动平均交叉系统。当指标值转向上时开多仓，转向下时开空仓，具有可配置的仓位管理和止损止盈设置。
EA-15979.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于i-CAi自定义指标的方向变化判断趋势转折，属于典型的趋势跟踪策略。入场条件为：当Value[1]<Value[2]且Value[0]>=Value[1]时开多仓，表示指标从下降转为上升，趋势向上启动；当Value[1]>Value[2]且Value[0]<=Value[1]时开空仓，表示指标从上升转为下降，趋势向下启动。出场条件依赖固定止损止盈（默认1000点止损、2000点止盈），同时支持反向信号平仓——开多信号触发空仓平仓，开空信号触发多仓平仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、含浮亏自由保证金比例、含浮亏余额比例和固定手数，通过MM和MMMode参数控制。资金管理使用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库的标准化交易函数，支持滑点控制（默认10点）和买卖开关独立控制。
EA-15979.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on directional changes in the custom i-CAi indicator to identify trend reversals, making it a classic trend-following system. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when Value[1]<Value[2] and Value[0]>=Value[1], indicating the indicator has turned from declining to rising and an uptrend is starting; a sell position opens when Value[1]>Value[2] and Value[0]<=Value[1], indicating the indicator has turned from rising to declining and a downtrend is starting. Exit conditions rely on fixed stop loss (default 1000 points) and take profit (default 2000 points), while also supporting reverse signal closures — a buy signal triggers closing of sell positions and a sell signal triggers closing of buy positions. Position sizing supports five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, free margin with floating loss, balance with floating loss, and fixed lot size, controlled by the MM and MMMode parameters. Money management uses standardized trading functions from the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, with slippage control (default 10 points) and independent buy/sell enable switches.

EA-15996.name: Exp_SMI_Correct
EA-15996.summary: This EA trades based on the SMI Correct indicator, which is a Stochastic Momentum Index variant with multi-layer smoothing. It generates buy signals when the SMI main line crosses above the signal line and sell signals on the reverse crossover, with configurable position sizing and stop loss/take profit management.
EA-15996.summary_zh: 该EA基于SMI Correct指标进行交易，SMI Correct是随机动量指数的一种多层级平滑变体。当SMI主线从下方穿越信号线时生成买入信号，反向穿越时生成卖出信号，并支持可配置的仓位管理和止损止盈管理。
EA-15996.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于SMI Correct指标的主线与信号线交叉。入场条件为：当指标主线从下方穿越信号线时开多仓，从上方穿越信号线时开空仓。出场条件包括止损和止盈，分别由StopLoss_和TakeProfit_参数控制，同时支持基于信号反向交叉的平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，并支持多种资金管理模式（可用保证金、余额、亏损后保证金、固定手数）。指标采用三重平滑（EMA、JJMA等），第一层平滑处理极值周期数据，第二层平滑主线，第三层平滑信号线。策略还使用了新K线判断机制（IsNewBar），避免在同一根K线内重复交易。
EA-15996.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the crossover of the SMI Correct indicator's main line and signal line. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the main line crosses above the signal line, and a sell position opens when the main line crosses below the signal line. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit controlled by StopLoss_ and TakeProfit_ parameters, along with signal-based closing when the crossover reverses direction. Position sizing is managed through the MM parameter which controls the risk percentage, supporting multiple margin modes including free margin, balance, loss-adjusted margin, and fixed lot size. The indicator employs triple smoothing (EMA, JJMA, etc.), where the first layer smooths the extremum period data, the second smooths the main line, and the third smooths the signal line. The strategy also uses a new bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) to prevent repeated trading within the same bar.

EA-16015.name: Exp_i-CAi_StDev
EA-16015.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom i-CAi_StDev indicator, which combines a smoothed moving average with standard deviation bands. It supports three signal modes (point signals, direct line direction, or disabled) for both entry and exit, and includes money management with multiple margin modes.
EA-16015.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义指标i-CAi_StDev的交易信号进行操作，该指标结合了平滑移动平均线和标准差通道。它支持三种信号模式（点信号、直接方向判断、禁用）分别控制入场和出场，并包含多种保证金模式的资金管理功能。
EA-16015.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于i-CAi_StDev指标的趋势跟踪交易系统。该指标使用可配置的平滑方法（SMA/EMA/JJMA/JurX等）对价格进行平滑处理，然后叠加标准差倍数（dK1=1.5, dK2=2.5）构建通道。入场条件分为三种模式：POINT模式通过指标缓冲区3/5（买入）或2/4（卖空）的非空值点信号触发；DIRECT模式通过主线的拐点判断（买入为主线上穿、卖空为主线下穿）触发；WITHOUT模式则禁用相应方向的开仓。出场条件同样支持三种模式，买入平仓可用卖卖点信号或主线下行判断，卖空平仓可用买点信号或主线上行判断。仓位管理采用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen函数，支持按自由保证金、余额、亏损后保证金等多种资金管理模式（MMMode参数），并通过MM参数控制风险比例。止损和止盈分别默认设为1000和2000点，提供了基本的风控框架。
EA-16015.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following trading system based on the i-CAi_StDev indicator. This indicator applies a configurable smoothing method (SMA/EMA/JJMA/JurX etc.) to price data, then overlays standard deviation multiples (dK1=1.5, dK2=2.5) to construct bands. Entry conditions are split into three modes: POINT mode triggers when indicator buffers 3/5 (buy) or 2/4 (sell) show non-empty dot signals; DIRECT mode triggers on main line turning points (buy on upward crossover, sell on downward crossover); WITHOUT mode disables the corresponding direction's entries. Exit conditions similarly support three modes - buy closing can use sell dot signals or main line declining logic, while sell closing can use buy dot signals or main line rising logic. Position sizing leverages the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library's BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen functions, supporting multiple money management modes including free margin-based, balance-based, and loss-adjusted margin calculations controlled by the MMMode parameter with risk ratio set via MM. Stop loss and take profit default to 1000 and 2000 points respectively, providing a basic risk control framework. The EA includes a new bar check mechanism and a recount flag to avoid redundant signal calculations on the same bar.

EA-16037.name: Exp_PFE
EA-16037.summary: This EA trades based on the Polarized Fractal Efficiency (PFE) indicator, entering long when PFE rises and short when PFE falls. It uses the CXMA smoothing library for signal generation and supports configurable money management modes including lot-based and percentage-based position sizing. The EA operates on a new bar basis with separate controls for opening and closing positions.
EA-16037.summary_zh: 该EA基于极化分形效率(PFE)指标进行交易，PFE上升时做多，PFE下降时做空。使用CXMA平滑算法库生成信号，支持包括固定手数和百分比在内的多种资金管理模式。EA基于新K线触发交易，并分别控制开仓和平仓操作。
EA-16037.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于极化分形效率(PFE)指标，该指标衡量价格运动的分形效率，值越高表示趋势越强越顺畅。入场条件为：当PFE前一值小于前两值（上升趋势）且当前值大于前一值（动量加速）时开多仓；当PFE前一值大于前两值（下降趋势）且当前值小于前一值（动量加速）时开空仓。出场条件依赖固定止损止盈，同时支持趋势反转时反向平仓（如持多仓时PFE转跌则平多）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode选择资金管理模式（余额、净值、固定手数等）。资金管理支持五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、扣除亏损后自由保证金比例、扣除亏损后余额比例、固定手数。信号仅在新生成K线时计算，避免逐tick重复开仓，但SignalBar为0时会在每个tick计算信号。
EA-16037.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Polarized Fractal Efficiency (PFE) indicator, which measures the fractal efficiency of price movement—higher values indicate a stronger, more efficient trend. Entry conditions: a long position is opened when the previous PFE value is less than the one before it (uptrend forming) and the current value exceeds the previous one (momentum accelerating); a short position is opened when the opposite conditions hold. Exit conditions rely on fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit values in points, with additional trend-reversal closes where a long is closed when PFE turns down and vice versa. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter specifying risk percentage, while MMMode selects from five money management modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Signals are computed only on new bars to prevent repeated tick-level entries, though setting SignalBar to zero triggers per-tick signal recalculation which could increase trade frequency undesirably.

EA-16044.name: Exp_PFE_Extr
EA-16044.summary: This EA trades based on the Polarized Fractal Efficiency (PFE) indicator, opening buy positions when PFE crosses above the upper level and sell positions when it crosses below the lower level. It uses multiple smoothing methods via the CXMA library and supports configurable money management modes including fixed lot and margin-based sizing. The strategy operates as a zero-lag crossover system on extreme PFE level breaches.
EA-16044.summary_zh: 该EA基于极化分形效率(PFE)指标进行交易，当PFE上穿上限水平时开多仓，下穿下限水平时开空仓。它通过CXMA库支持多种平滑方法，并支持包括固定手数和基于保证金的仓位管理模式。该策略作为零滞后交叉系统在PFE极值突破时运行。
EA-16044.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于极化分形效率(PFE)指标，PFE衡量价格运动的效率程度，正值表示上升趋势效率高，负值表示下降趋势效率高。入场条件为：当PFE值从下方突破UpLevel(+0.5)时开多仓，当PFE值从上方跌破DnLevel(-0.5)时开空仓，使用SignalBar=1确认交叉突破。出场条件包括：当PFE跌破下限时平多仓，当PFE升破上限时平空仓，同时设有止损1000点和止盈2000点。仓位管理支持五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、扣除亏损后自由保证金比例、扣除亏损后余额比例、固定手数，默认使用固定手数模式。信号仅在NewBar时判断以避免重复交易，但缺乏对现有持仓数量的检查，可能在已有同向持仓时重复开仓。
EA-16044.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy is based on the Polarized Fractal Efficiency (PFE) indicator, which measures the efficiency of price movement—positive values indicate high uptrend efficiency and negative values indicate high downtrend efficiency. Entry conditions: open a buy when PFE crosses above UpLevel (+0.5) from below, and open a sell when PFE crosses below DnLevel (-0.5) from above, with SignalBar=1 used to confirm the crossover. Exit conditions include closing long positions when PFE drops below the lower level, closing short positions when PFE rises above the upper level, along with a StopLoss of 1000 points and TakeProfit of 2000 points. Position sizing supports five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-adjusted free margin, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot, defaulting to fixed lot mode. Signals are evaluated only on new bars to avoid redundant trades, but there is no check for existing positions in the same direction, which may lead to duplicate entries.

EA-16066.name: Exp_PPO_Cloud
EA-16066.summary: This EA trades based on the PPO (Percentage Price Oscillator) Cloud indicator, which uses dual smoothing methods for fast and slow PPO lines plus a signal line. It opens buy positions when the PPO crosses above the signal line from below, and sell positions when the PPO crosses below the signal line from above, with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels.
EA-16066.summary_zh: 该EA基于PPO Cloud指标进行交易，使用快慢两根PPO线和信号线的交叉来产生买卖信号。当PPO从下方穿越信号线时开多仓，从上方穿越信号线时开空仓，并设有可配置的止损和止盈水平。
EA-16066.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于PPO（百分比价格振荡器）Cloud指标，该指标是对传统MACD的改进版本，使用可自定义的平滑算法替代固定的EMA。入场条件为：当快线Ind从下方穿越信号线Sign时产生买入信号（Ind[1]>Sign[1]且Ind[0]<=Sign[0]），当快线从上方穿越信号线时产生卖出信号（Ind[1]<Sign[1]且Ind[0]>=Sign[0]）。出场条件依赖独立的止损和止盈参数，同时当反向交叉信号出现时也会平掉对应仓位（如做多时出现空头信号则平多仓）。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制，支持按自由保证金、余额、亏损后余额或固定手数等五种模式计算仓位。资金管理方面，MM参数默认0.1表示仓位比例，结合不同的保证金模式实现灵活的资金分配。策略还通过IsNewBar机制确保信号只在新的K线开盘时计算，避免逐tick重复交易。
EA-16066.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the PPO (Percentage Price Oscillator) Cloud indicator, an improved version of the traditional MACD that uses customizable smoothing algorithms instead of fixed EMAs. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is generated when the fast line Ind crosses above the signal line Sign (Ind[1]>Sign[1] and Ind[0]<=Sign[0]), and a sell signal is generated when the fast line crosses below the signal line (Ind[1]<Sign[1] and Ind[0]>=Sign[0]). Exit conditions rely on separate stop-loss and take-profit parameters (default 1000 and 2000 points respectively), while opposing crossover signals also trigger position closure (e.g., a bearish crossover closes long positions). Position sizing is controlled through the MM parameter and MMMode enumeration, supporting five modes: free margin-based, balance-based, loss-free margin-based, loss-balance-based, and fixed lot sizing. Money management uses the MM parameter (default 0.1) as a position ratio combined with different margin modes for flexible capital allocation. The strategy also employs the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are only calculated at new bar openings, preventing redundant tick-by-tick trading.

EA-16081.name: Exp_CandlesticksBW
EA-16081.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom CandlesticksBW indicator, opening buy positions when bullish candlestick patterns are detected and sell positions when bearish patterns are confirmed. It uses a dual-buffer signal system (buffer 4) with threshold comparisons to generate entry and exit signals, and employs fixed Stop Loss/Take Profit levels with configurable money management.
EA-16081.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义CandlesticksBW指标的信号进行交易，在检测到看涨K线形态时开多仓，在确认看跌形态时开空仓。它使用双缓冲区信号系统（第4缓冲区）通过阈值比较生成入场和出场信号，并采用固定止损/止盈水平及可配置的资金管理方式。
EA-16081.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念基于CandlesticksBW指标识别的K线形态信号进行趋势跟踪交易。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区4的前一个值小于2且当前值大于1时开多仓；当指标缓冲区4的前一个值大于3且当前值小于4时开空仓。出场条件为：开多仓信号同时触发空仓平仓，开空仓信号同时触发多仓平仓，形成简单的反向平仓逻辑。仓位管理通过MM参数控制交易手数比例，MMMode参数选择手数计算模式（固定手数或基于保证金的比例计算）。资金管理方面，使用固定的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点）设置，盈亏比为2:1，但没有根据市场波动性动态调整止损止盈的机制。策略默认在H4周期运行，使用SMA作为指标的计算方法，信号延迟为1根K线。
EA-16081.strategy_analysis_en: The EA's strategy concept is based on candlestick pattern signals identified by the CandlesticksBW indicator for directional trading. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when indicator buffer 4's previous value is less than 2 and current value exceeds 1; a sell position opens when the previous value exceeds 3 and current value is less than 4. Exit conditions: a buy signal simultaneously triggers closing of sell positions, and a sell signal simultaneously triggers closing of buy positions, implementing a simple reversal-based exit logic. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter which sets the trading lot ratio, with MMMode selecting between fixed lot size or margin-based proportional calculation. Money management uses fixed Stop Loss (1000 points) and Take Profit (2000 points) with a 2:1 reward-to-risk ratio, but lacks dynamic adjustment based on market volatility. The strategy defaults to H4 timeframe using SMA as the indicator's calculation method with a 1-bar signal delay.

EA-16100.name: Exp_RAVI_Histogram
EA-16100.summary: This EA trades based on the RAVI (Range Action Verification Index) Histogram indicator, which measures momentum by comparing fast and slow moving averages. It opens buy positions when the RAVI value crosses above the upper level and sell positions when it crosses below the lower level, with corresponding close signals for opposite positions.
EA-16100.summary_zh: 该EA基于RAVI直方图指标进行交易，通过比较快速和慢速移动平均线来衡量动量。当RAVI值从下方穿越上轨时开多仓，从上方穿越下轨时开空仓，同时对反向持仓发出平仓信号。
EA-16100.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是RAVI（Range Action Verification Index）直方图指标，通过计算快速和慢速平滑移动平均线的差值来衡量市场动量方向。入场条件为：当RAVI值高于上轨（UpLevel=+0.1）且前一根柱的值低于上轨时，触发做多开仓信号；当RAVI值低于下轨（DnLevel=-0.1）且前一根柱的值高于下轨时，触发做空开仓信号。出场条件方面，做多信号触发时同时平空仓，做空信号触发时同时平多仓，另外设有固定止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，支持多种保证金模式（自由保证金、余额、亏损后余额、固定手数）。资金管理采用MarginMode枚举，默认为固定手数模式（LOT），MM=0.1表示资金分配比例。策略使用IsNewBar机制确保仅在新的K线形成时执行信号判断，避免重复交易，同时通过SignalBar参数控制使用哪根K线的信号。
EA-16100.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the RAVI (Range Action Verification Index) Histogram indicator, which measures market momentum direction by calculating the difference between fast and slow smoothed moving averages. Entry conditions: when the RAVI value is above the upper level (UpLevel=+0.1) and the previous bar's value was below or equal to the upper level, a buy open signal is triggered; when the RAVI value is below the lower level (DnLevel=-0.1) and the previous bar's value was above or equal to the lower level, a sell open signal is triggered. For exit conditions, when a buy signal triggers, existing sell positions are simultaneously closed, and vice versa; additionally, fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) are configured. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter which sets the risk ratio, supporting multiple margin modes including free margin, balance, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot size. Money management uses the MarginMode enumeration, defaulting to fixed lot mode (LOT), with MM=0.1 representing the capital allocation ratio. The strategy employs an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signal evaluation only occurs on new bar formation, preventing duplicate trades, while the SignalBar parameter controls which bar's signal is used for analysis.

EA-16109.name: Exp_i-SpectrAnalysis_RVI
EA-16109.summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the i-SpectrAnalysis_RVI custom indicator, which applies spectral analysis to the RVI (Relative Vigor Index). It opens buy positions when the RVI main line crosses above the signal line and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable position sizing and stop-loss/take-profit levels.
EA-16109.summary_zh: 该EA基于i-SpectrAnalysis_RVI自定义指标的交叉信号进行交易，该指标对RVI（相对活力指数）进行频谱分析处理。当RVI主线上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿时开空仓，支持可配置的仓位管理和止损止盈。
EA-16109.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用经频谱分析处理后的RVI指标的线间交叉来捕捉动量转折点。入场条件为：当Line1（RVI主线）从下方穿越Line2（RVI信号线）时产生买入信号，反之产生卖出信号；同时在上一根K线已确认趋势方向的前提下才开仓，即Line1[1]>Line2[1]且Line1[0]<=Line2[0]时才触发买入，这实际上是一种回拉入场而非突破入场。出场条件依赖止损止盈参数，同时支持反向信号平仓（BuyPosClose/SellPosClose可配置）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，支持固定手数或基于保证金比例的两种模式（LOT和MMMode）。资金管理使用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库中的标准化函数处理开平仓逻辑，包含滑点容忍设置Deviation_。策略使用SignalBar参数控制信号检测的K线位置，默认为1即使用已完成K线信号，避免未来函数问题。
EA-16109.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy captures momentum turning points using crossover signals from a spectrally-analyzed RVI indicator. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when Line1 (RVI main) crosses above Line2 (RVI signal), and a sell signal on the opposite crossover; however, the EA requires confirmation from the previous bar (Line1[1]>Line2[1]) combined with a pullback (Line1[0]<=Line2[0]) to trigger buys, making this a pullback-entry rather than a breakout-entry system. Exit conditions rely on configurable StopLoss and TakeProfit levels, with optional reverse-signal closes (BuyPosClose/SellPosClose toggles). Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, supporting both fixed lot size and margin-based proportional sizing through two modes (LOT and MMMode). Money management leverages standardized functions from the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for opening and closing positions, including a slippage tolerance setting (Deviation_). The strategy uses SignalBar to control which bar's signal is evaluated, defaulting to 1 (last completed bar), which avoids repainting issues.

EA-16117.name: Exp_i-SpectrAnalysis_WPR
EA-16117.summary: This EA trades based on a spectral analysis filter applied to the Williams Percent Range (WPR) indicator. It identifies turning points in the smoothed WPR line to generate buy and sell signals, opening and closing positions accordingly with configurable money management and stop-loss/take-profit levels.
EA-16117.summary_zh: 该EA基于对威廉指标(WPR)进行频谱分析滤波后的信号进行交易。它识别平滑WPR线的拐点来产生买卖信号，并据此开平仓，支持可配置的资金管理和止损止盈。
EA-16117.strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是对WPR（威廉百分比范围）指标进行频谱分析滤波处理，去除高频噪声后提取主要趋势转折信号。入场条件为：当滤波后WPR值从下降转为上升（Value[0]>=Value[1]且Value[1]<Value[2]）时开多仓，当从上升转为下降（Value[0]<=Value[1]且Value[1]>Value[2]）时开空仓。出场条件由反向信号触发，即多头在出现空头信号时平仓，空头在出现多头信号时平仓，同时设有固定的止损和止盈。仓位管理支持五种模式：按可用保证金比例、按余额比例、按可用保证金减浮亏比例、按余额减浮亏比例、或固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制交易量比例，MMMode参数选择具体的计算模式。策略使用了IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易。
EA-16117.strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is applying spectral analysis filtering to the WPR (Williams Percent Range) indicator, removing high-frequency noise to extract major trend reversal signals. Entry conditions: a buy position is opened when the filtered WPR value turns from declining to rising (Value[0]>=Value[1] and Value[1]<Value[2]), and a sell position is opened when it turns from rising to declining (Value[0]<=Value[1] and Value[1]>Value[2]). Exit conditions are triggered by opposing signals — long positions close on bearish signals and short positions close on bullish signals, with additional fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing supports five modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin minus floating loss, percentage of balance minus floating loss, or fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter for trade volume ratio and the MMMode parameter for selecting the specific calculation mode. The strategy uses an IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing redundant trades.

EA-16122.name: Exp_wlxBW5Zone
EA-16122.summary: This EA trades based on the wlxBW5Zone custom indicator, which appears to be a Bill Williams Zone-based momentum indicator. It opens buy positions on upward zone signals and sell positions on downward zone signals, with configurable entry/exit toggles, fixed stop loss/take profit, and multiple money management modes.
EA-16122.summary_zh: 该EA基于wlxBW5Zone自定义指标进行交易，该指标似乎是基于比尔·威廉姆斯区域的动量指标。它在上方区域信号时开多仓，在下方区域信号时开空仓，具有可配置的入场/出场开关、固定止损止盈以及多种资金管理模式。
EA-16122.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Bill Williams的5维区域理论（wlxBW5Zone指标），通过检测动量区域变化来捕捉趋势方向。入场条件为：当指标上轨缓冲区（buffer 1）在指定信号K线上产生非零且非空值时开多仓，当指标下轨缓冲区（buffer 0）产生信号时开空仓。出场条件包括固定止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点），同时支持反向信号平仓——当持仓方向与新区号信号相反时关闭现有仓位。仓位管理提供了五种模式：基于可用保证金、基于余额、基于净可用保证金、基于净余额和固定手数模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode参数选择计算模式。EA还实现了新K线检测机制（IsNewBar），避免同一K线内重复交易，并通过历史数据加载确保指标计算完整性。
EA-16122.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on Bill Williams' 5-dimensional zone theory via the wlxBW5Zone indicator, detecting momentum zone changes to capture trend direction. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the upper buffer (buffer 1) produces a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE signal on the specified signal bar; a sell position opens on the lower buffer (buffer 0) signal. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points), plus reverse-signal closing where existing positions are closed when a contrary zone signal appears. Position sizing supports five modes: free margin-based, balance-based, net free margin, net balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter for risk proportion and MMMode for the calculation mode. The EA implements a new bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) to prevent duplicate trades within the same bar, and loads historical data to ensure complete indicator calculation. Additionally, a retrospective loop scans historical bars to detect prior close signals when no current close signal is generated but both open and close flags are enabled.

EA-16214.name: Exp_BalanceOfPower_Histogram
EA-16214.summary: This EA trades based on the Balance of Power (BOP) histogram indicator, which measures the strength of buyers vs sellers. It opens buy positions when BOP values are rising (buyers gaining strength) and sell positions when BOP values are falling (sellers gaining strength), with configurable smoothing applied to the indicator values.
EA-16214.summary_zh: 该EA基于力量平衡(BOP)直方图指标进行交易，该指标衡量买方与卖方的力量对比。当BOP值上升时开多仓，当BOP值下降时开空仓，并支持对指标值进行可配置的平滑处理。
EA-16214.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于Balance of Power直方图指标的动量变化进行交易。入场条件：当BOP值连续上升（Value[0]>Value[1]且Value[1]<Value[2]）时触发买入信号，表示买方力量正在增强；当BOP值连续下降（Value[0]<Value[1]且Value[1]>Value[2]）时触发卖出信号，表示卖方力量正在增强。出场条件包括止损和止盈的硬性设置，以及反向信号触发的平仓——买入信号出现时平掉卖仓，卖出信号出现时平掉买仓。仓位管理采用多种资金管理模式，包括基于自由保证金、余额、扣除亏损后的余额等比例计算，以及固定手数模式。指标值经过可配置的平滑算法（如T3、JJMA、JurX等）处理，以减少噪音干扰。整体策略属于动量跟踪类型，跟随市场买卖力量的变化方向进场。
EA-16214.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA trades based on momentum changes in the Balance of Power histogram indicator. Entry conditions: a buy signal is triggered when BOP values are consecutively rising (Value[0]>Value[1] and Value[1]<Value[2]), indicating buyers are gaining strength; a sell signal is triggered when BOP values are consecutively falling (Value[0]<Value[1] and Value[1]>Value[2]), indicating sellers are gaining strength. Exit conditions include hard stop-loss and take-profit settings, as well as signal-based position closing—sell positions are closed when a buy signal appears, and buy positions are closed when a sell signal appears. Position sizing supports multiple money management modes including proportional calculation based on free margin, balance, or balance minus floating loss, as well as a fixed lot mode. The indicator values are processed through configurable smoothing algorithms (such as T3, JJMA, JurX, etc.) to reduce market noise. The overall strategy is a momentum-following type, entering trades in the direction of shifting buyer-seller power dynamics.

EA-16215.name: Exp_i-SpectrAnalysis_Chaikin
EA-16215.summary: This EA trades based on the i-SpectrAnalysis_Chaikin custom indicator, which applies spectral (Fourier) analysis to the Chaikin Oscillator. It opens buy positions when the spectrally-filtered Chaikin value turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable position closing on signal reversal.
EA-16215.summary_zh: 该EA基于i-SpectrAnalysis_Chaikin自定义指标进行交易，该指标对蔡金震荡指标应用频谱（傅里叶）分析进行滤波处理。当滤波后的蔡金值向上转折时开多仓，向下转折时开空仓，并可在信号反转时平仓。
EA-16215.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于对蔡金震荡指标（Chaikin Oscillator）进行频谱分析滤波，去除高频噪声后提取主要趋势转折信号。入场条件：当滤波后的指标值从前一根到当前一根上升（Value[0]>=Value[1]）且前一根低于再前一根（Value[1]<Value[2]，即底部转折）时开多仓；当滤波后的指标值下降且前一根高于再前一根（顶部转折）时开空仓。出场条件：当信号反转时平仓——多仓在指标从上升转为下降时平仓，空仓在指标从下降转为上升时平仓，同时设有固定的止损和止盈。仓位管理支持多种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后余额比例、按亏损后自由保证金比例，以及固定手数模式。频谱分析通过N参数控制傅里叶变换的幂次（2^N个数据点），SS参数控制平滑程度，从而在去噪和信号延迟之间取得平衡。
EA-16215.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on applying spectral (Fourier) analysis filtering to the Chaikin Oscillator, removing high-frequency noise to extract major trend reversal signals. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the filtered indicator value rises from the previous bar to the current bar (Value[0]>=Value[1]) and the previous bar was below the bar before it (Value[1]<Value[2], indicating a bottom reversal); a sell position opens when the filtered value declines and a top reversal pattern forms. Exit conditions: positions close on signal reversal — long positions close when the indicator turns from rising to falling, and short positions close when it turns from falling to rising, with additional fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing supports multiple modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage after loss adjustments, and fixed lot size. The spectral analysis is controlled by parameter N (power of 2 for Fourier transform data points) and SS (smoothing strength), balancing noise removal against signal lag.

EA-16222.name: Exp_RVIDiff
EA-16222.summary: This EA trades based on the RVIDiff custom indicator, which applies additional smoothing (T3 by default) to the Relative Vigor Index. It opens buy positions when the RVI value rises above its prior value during a downtrend in the RVI, and opens sell positions when the RVI falls below its prior value during an uptrend, with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels.
EA-16222.summary_zh: 该EA基于RVIDiff自定义指标进行交易，该指标对相对活力指数(RVI)进行了额外的平滑处理（默认T3）。当RVI在下降趋势中拐头向上时开多仓，在上升趋势中拐头向下时开空仓，并设有可配置的止损和止盈。
EA-16222.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于RVIDiff指标的动量反转信号。入场条件：当RVI值[1]小于[2]（即RVI下降趋势中），且当前值[0]大于等于[1]（即RVI拐头向上）时，触发买入信号；反之当RVI值[1]大于[2]且当前值[0]小于等于[1]时，触发卖出信号。出场条件包括固定点数的止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点），以及反向信号触发的平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，支持多种保证金模式（余额比例、净值比例、固定手数等）。资金管理使用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库提供的标准化仓位计算。策略在H6周期上运行，使用SignalBar=1即前一根K线的信号，避免未来数据偏差。
EA-16222.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on momentum reversal signals from the RVIDiff indicator, which smooths the standard RVI with an additional averaging method (T3 by default). Entry conditions: a buy signal is triggered when RVI[1] < RVI[2] (downtrend) and RVI[0] >= RVI[1] (momentum turning upward); a sell signal is triggered when RVI[1] > RVI[2] (uptrend) and RVI[0] <= RVI[1] (momentum turning downward). Exit conditions include a fixed 1000-point stop-loss, 2000-point take-profit, and closing positions on opposing signals. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter with multiple margin modes including balance-based, free margin-based, and fixed lot sizing. Money management leverages the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for standardized position calculation. The strategy operates on H6 timeframe by default, using SignalBar=1 to reference the previous bar's values, avoiding look-ahead bias.

EA-16231.name: FibonacciRetracement
EA-16231.summary: This EA uses ZigZag indicator to identify swing highs and lows, then constructs Fibonacci retracement levels on the most recent ZigZag leg. It enters buy trades when price crosses above Fibonacci support levels in an uptrend, and sell trades when price crosses below Fibonacci resistance levels in a downtrend, with stop-loss and take-profit based on Fibonacci extension.
EA-16231.summary_zh: 该EA利用ZigZag指标识别波段高低点，然后在最近的ZigZag波段上构建斐波那契回撤水平。在上升趋势中价格突破斐波那契支撑位时做多，在下降趋势中价格跌破斐波那契阻力位时做空，止损和止盈基于斐波那契扩展计算。
EA-16231.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于斐波那契回撤理论，认为价格在趋势中会回撤至特定斐波那契比例水平后继续原趋势方向运行。入场条件：在上升趋势中，当收盘价突破23.6%、38.2%、61.8%或76.4%回撤位且前一根K线收盘价低于该水平时做多；在下降趋势中，当收盘价跌破上述回撤位且前一根K线收盘价高于该水平时做空。出场条件：止损设在固定点数（StopLossLevel参数）距离处，止盈设在Fibo00加上TakeProfitAt乘以FiboBASE的斐波那契扩展位。仓位管理采用固定手数（TradeValue参数），没有动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面缺乏最大回撤控制、最大持仓限制和风险比例计算，仅依赖固定止损和止盈。趋势判断通过CheckTrend函数比较最近四个ZigZag拐点的高低关系来确定。
EA-16231.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on Fibonacci retracement theory, assuming that price retraces to specific Fibonacci ratio levels within a trend before continuing in the original direction. Entry conditions: in an uptrend, buy when the close price breaks above the 23.6%, 38.2%, 61.8%, or 76.4% retracement level while the previous bar's close was below that level; in a downtrend, sell when the close price breaks below those retracement levels while the previous bar's close was above. Exit conditions: stop-loss is set at a fixed point distance (StopLossLevel parameter) from the entry price, and take-profit is set at the Fibo00 level plus TakeProfitAt multiplied by FiboBASE (Fibonacci extension). Position sizing uses a fixed lot size (TradeValue parameter) with no dynamic position adjustment mechanism. Money management lacks maximum drawdown control, maximum position limits, and risk-per-trade percentage calculation, relying solely on fixed stop-loss and take-profit. Trend determination is performed by the CheckTrend function comparing the relative heights of the four most recent ZigZag pivot points.

EA-16245.name: Exp_STLMCandle
EA-16245.summary: This EA trades based on signals from the custom STLMCandle indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator signals bullish momentum and sell positions on bearish momentum. It uses a Jurik-style smoothed indicator (JLength/JPhase parameters) to determine trend direction from candle color states. Entry and exit are controlled by separate boolean flags, allowing selective enablement of long/short opening and closing.
EA-16245.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义STLMCandle指标信号进行交易，当指标显示看涨动能时开多仓，看跌动能时开空仓。它使用Jurik平滑指标参数来确定趋势方向，入场和出场由独立的布尔开关控制。
EA-16245.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于STLMCandle自定义指标的颜色状态判断趋势方向，指标缓冲区4返回颜色值，当颜色值为2时表示上升趋势，为0时表示下降趋势。入场条件：当Clr[1]==2且Clr[0]<2时触发买入开仓信号，当Clr[1]==0且Clr[0]>0时触发卖出开仓信号，这种颜色状态变化检测实质上是趋势转折的确认。出场条件：当出现相反趋势信号时自动平仓，买入信号触发卖仓平仓，卖出信号触发买仓平仓。仓位管理通过MMMode参数支持多种模式，包括固定手数、基于余额百分比、基于可用保证金百分比等方式。资金管理采用固定止损止盈模式，默认止损1000点、止盈2000点，风险回报比为1:2。策略仅在新K线形成时计算信号，避免逐tick重复计算，提高了效率。
EA-16245.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the STLMCandle custom indicator's color state to determine trend direction, where indicator buffer 4 returns color values: 2 for uptrend and 0 for downtrend. Entry conditions: when Clr[1]==2 and Clr[0]<2, a buy signal is triggered; when Clr[1]==0 and Clr[0]>0, a sell signal is triggered, which detects color state transitions as trend reversal confirmations. Exit conditions: opposite trend signals automatically close existing positions, with buy signals closing sell positions and sell signals closing buy positions. Position sizing supports multiple modes through the MMMode parameter, including fixed lot size, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin, and percentage of loss-adjusted margin. Money management uses fixed stop loss and take profit with defaults of 1000 and 2000 points respectively, yielding a risk-reward ratio of 1:2. The strategy only recalculates signals on new bar formation using the CIsNewBar class, avoiding redundant per-tick computation and improving efficiency.

EA-16255.name: Exp_StochasticDiff
EA-16255.summary: This EA trades based on the StochasticDiff custom indicator, which applies an additional smoothing algorithm to the Stochastic Oscillator. It opens buy positions when the smoothed Stochastic value turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable position closing on opposite signals.
EA-16255.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义指标StochasticDiff进行交易，该指标对随机振荡器应用额外的平滑算法。当平滑后的随机值向上拐头时开多仓，向下拐头时开空仓，并可在反向信号时平仓。
EA-16255.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于对传统随机振荡器的差异化处理：先计算标准Stochastic指标，再对其结果应用用户可选的平滑算法（如T3、JJMA、JurX等），从而过滤噪音并提取趋势动量方向。入场条件为：当平滑后的Stochastic值连续上升（Value[0]>=Value[1]且Value[1]<Value[2]）时开多仓，当连续下降（Value[0]<=Value[1]且Value[1]>Value[2]）时开空仓，本质是捕捉动量拐点。出场条件依赖反向信号平仓，同时也设置了固定的止损和止盈（默认1000和2000点）。仓位管理支持五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、扣除亏损后保证金比例、扣除亏损后余额比例、固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，默认0.1即10%。策略还通过IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易，但缺乏对市场波动率、点差和流动性的过滤。
EA-16255.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a differentiated treatment of the traditional Stochastic Oscillator: it first calculates the standard Stochastic indicator and then applies a user-selectable smoothing algorithm (such as T3, JJMA, JurX, etc.) to filter noise and extract trend momentum direction. Entry conditions are: a buy position opens when the smoothed Stochastic value turns upward (Value[0]>=Value[1] and Value[1]<Value[2]), and a sell position opens when it turns downward (Value[0]<=Value[1] and Value[1]>Value[2]), essentially capturing momentum inflection points. Exit conditions rely on opposite signals for position closing, while also setting fixed stop loss and take profit levels (default 1000 and 2000 points respectively). Position sizing supports five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, free margin after loss percentage, balance after loss percentage, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter with a default of 0.1 (10% risk). The strategy also uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, avoiding repeated trades, but lacks filters for market volatility, spread, and liquidity.

EA-16337.name: synccharts
EA-16337.summary: This EA synchronizes all open charts in the terminal to match the active chart's timeframe, scale, scroll position, chart mode, and vertical line objects. It runs on a 200ms timer, continuously propagating the source chart's view settings to every other chart. It does not place any trades or manage positions.
EA-16337.summary_zh: 这个EA将终端中所有打开的图表同步为与当前活跃图表相同的时间周期、缩放比例、滚动位置、图表模式和垂直线对象。它以200毫秒定时器持续运行，将源图表的视图设置传播到其他所有图表。它不进行任何交易或仓位管理。
EA-16337.strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略，而是一个图表同步工具。其核心概念是通过定时器每200毫秒检测当前图表的视图状态，包括时间周期、缩放级别、首个可见K线位置、图表模式（蜡烛图/线图等）以及垂直线对象。入场条件不适用，因为没有交易信号逻辑。出场条件同样不适用，因为该EA不管理任何仓位。仓位管理和资金管理均不存在，因为其功能纯粹是UI层面的图表视图同步。策略上，它禁用了自动滚动和偏移功能，确保所有图表保持在相同的滚动位置，并将垂直线对象的属性（颜色、宽度、样式、选中状态）完整复制到其他图表。其设计意图是让交易者在多图表分析时保持视图一致性，方便跨品种或跨周期的视觉对比。
EA-16337.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy but a chart synchronization utility. Its core concept is to poll the active chart's view state every 200 milliseconds via a timer, capturing timeframe, scale level, first visible bar position, chart mode (candlestick/line etc.), and vertical line objects. Entry conditions are not applicable since there is no trade signal logic. Exit conditions are similarly inapplicable as the EA does not manage any positions. Position sizing and money management are nonexistent because its functionality is purely at the UI level for chart view synchronization. Strategically, it disables auto-scroll and shift features on both the source and target charts, ensuring all charts remain at the same scroll position. It also fully replicates vertical line object properties including color, width, style, and selected state across all other open charts. Its design intent is to let traders maintain view consistency during multi-chart analysis, facilitating visual comparison across instruments or timeframes.

EA-12942.name: MD5 Cloud Decryptor
EA-12942.summary: MD5 Cloud Decryptor is a utility Expert Advisor that connects to cloud-based MD5 hash decryption services to resolve hash values. It does not execute any trading operations and serves purely as an informational/analytical tool within the MetaTrader 5 environment.
EA-12942.summary_zh: MD5 Cloud Decryptor是一个工具类EA，连接云端MD5哈希解密服务来解析哈希值。它不执行任何交易操作，纯粹作为MetaTrader 5环境中的信息/分析工具使用。
EA-12942.strategy_analysis: 该EA并非交易策略程序，而是一个工具类应用程序，主要功能是通过网络请求连接云端MD5解密数据库来破解或查询MD5哈希值。其不涉及任何入场条件或出场条件的设计，因为没有交易信号的生成逻辑。仓位管理和资金管理在此EA中完全不适用，因为它不会开仓或管理任何交易头寸。该工具的核心逻辑在于构造HTTP请求、发送哈希值到云端API、解析返回结果并展示给用户。整体设计思路偏向于网络通信与数据解析，与金融市场交易策略无关。
EA-12942.strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy program but rather a utility application whose primary function is to connect to cloud-based MD5 decryption databases via network requests to crack or query MD5 hash values. It does not involve any entry or exit condition design since there is no trading signal generation logic. Position sizing and money management are completely inapplicable to this EA because it does not open or manage any trading positions. The core logic revolves around constructing HTTP requests, sending hash values to cloud APIs, parsing returned results, and displaying them to the user. The overall design approach is oriented toward network communication and data parsing, having no relation to financial market trading strategies.

EA-15334.name: Exp_ColorJFatl_StDev
EA-15334.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorJFatl_StDev custom indicator, which combines a JFATL (JMA-smoothed FATL) moving average with Standard Deviation channels. It opens and closes positions using three signal modes: point-based (dot signals), directional (line direction change), or disabled, allowing flexible entry and exit logic on trend reversals or continuations.
EA-15334.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorJFatl_StDev自定义指标进行交易，该指标结合了JFATL（JMA平滑FATL）移动平均线和标准差通道。它支持三种信号模式（点信号、方向信号、禁用）来开仓和平仓，在趋势反转或延续时灵活执行交易。
EA-15334.strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于JFATL（JMA平滑的FATL数字滤波器）指标配合标准差通道进行趋势跟踪交易。入场条件有两种模式：POINT模式通过检测指标缓冲区中的买入/卖出点信号（非EMPTY_VALUE）来触发开仓；DIRECT模式通过检测JFATL线的方向变化（如底部转折或顶部转折）来触发。出场条件同样支持两种模式：POINT模式使用相反方向的点信号平仓；DIRECT模式在JFATL线方向反转时平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode枚举控制，支持按自由保证金比例、余额比例、亏损后保证金/余额比例或固定手数五种模式。资金管理使用TradeAlgorithms.mqh库函数，支持止损和止盈设置，并有偏差滑点控制。策略通过SignalBar参数允许在非零号K线上取信号以实现回测验证，同时使用IsNewBar机制避免同一根K线内重复计算。
EA-15334.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy core is trend-following based on the JFATL indicator (a JMA-smoothed FATL digital filter) combined with Standard Deviation channels. Entry conditions operate in two modes: POINT mode triggers trades when dot signals appear in the indicator buffers (non-EMPTY_VALUE values); DIRECT mode triggers on JFATL line direction changes such as bottom reversals (Line[0]>Line[1] && Line[1]<Line[2]) or top reversals. Exit conditions mirror entry logic with two modes: POINT mode uses opposite-direction dot signals for closing; DIRECT mode closes when the JFATL line direction reverses. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter and MMMode enum, supporting five modes including percentage of free margin, balance, post-loss margin/balance, or fixed lot size. Money management leverages the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library with configurable stop loss, take profit, and slippage deviation control. The strategy allows signal verification on non-zero bars via SignalBar and uses an IsNewBar mechanism to prevent redundant calculations within the same bar.

EA-15761.name: Exp_Directed_Movement_Candle
EA-15761.summary: This EA trades based on the Directed_Movement_Candle custom indicator, which uses a dual-smoothed RSI approach to determine directional momentum. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals bullish momentum (color value 2) and sell positions when it signals bearish momentum (color value 0), with configurable stop loss and take profit levels. The EA uses a new bar detection mechanism to avoid redundant signal processing and supports both trade opening and closing based on indicator signals.
EA-15761.summary_zh: 该EA基于Directed_Movement_Candle自定义指标进行交易，该指标采用双重平滑RSI方法来确定方向性动量。当指标发出看涨动量信号（颜色值为2）时开多仓，发出看跌动量信号（颜色值为0）时开空仓，并设有可配置的止损和止盈水平。EA使用新K线检测机制避免重复信号处理，同时支持基于指标信号的开仓和平仓操作。
EA-15761.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Directed_Movement_Candle指标，该指标内部使用RSI经过两层不同平滑算法处理后的结果来判断市场方向性动量。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区4的当前值为2（看涨）且前一根K线值小于2时开多仓；当当前值为0（看跌）且前一根K线值大于0时开空仓。出场条件包括：当指标信号反转时主动平仓（多转空时平多仓，空转多时平空仓），以及固定的止损1000点和止盈2000点。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，支持固定手数或基于保证金比例的动态手数模式。资金管理使用MarginMode枚举选择手数计算方式，默认0.1的保证金比例相对保守。策略允许用户独立控制买入和卖出的开仓与平仓开关，提供了灵活的交易方向配置。
EA-15761.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Directed_Movement_Candle indicator, which internally uses RSI processed through two different smoothing algorithms to determine directional market momentum. Entry conditions are: open a buy position when indicator buffer 4's current value is 2 (bullish) and the previous bar's value is less than 2; open a sell position when the current value is 0 (bearish) and the previous bar's value is greater than 0. Exit conditions include: active position closing when the indicator signal reverses (close buy when signal turns bearish, close sell when signal turns bullish), plus fixed stop loss at 1000 points and take profit at 2000 points. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter, supporting either fixed lots or dynamic lot sizing based on margin percentage. Money management uses the MarginMode enumeration to select lot calculation method, with a default 0.1 margin ratio being relatively conservative. The strategy allows users to independently control buy and sell opening and closing switches, providing flexible trading direction configuration.

EA-16341.name: Exp_ColorXvaMA_Digit
EA-16341.summary: This EA trades based on the ColorXvaMA_Digit custom indicator, which applies a double-smoothing approach using two configurable moving average methods. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend and sell positions when it signals a downtrend, with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit settings.
EA-16341.summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorXvaMA_Digit自定义指标进行交易，该指标采用两种可配置平滑方法的双重平滑处理。当指标发出上升趋势信号时开多仓，发出下降趋势信号时开空仓，具有可配置的资金管理、止损和止盈设置。
EA-16341.strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双重平滑移动平均线的颜色变化信号进行趋势跟踪交易。入场条件：当指标缓冲区1的值为1且前一值小于1时开多仓，当值为0且前一值大于0时开空仓，即检测趋势方向转换的时刻。出场条件：当趋势反向信号出现时平仓（BUY_Close或SELL_Close），同时设有固定的止损和止盈点数。仓位管理支持五种模式：自由保证金比例、余额比例、亏损自由保证金比例、亏损余额比例和固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode参数决定计算基准。该EA在新K线形成时或需要重新计算时才执行信号检测，避免重复交易。指标使用了XMA（扩展移动平均）双重平滑，第一层为EMA平滑，第二层为JJMA平滑，增强了趋势判断的可靠性。
EA-16341.strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on trend-following trading using color change signals from a double-smoothed moving average indicator. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when indicator buffer 1 equals 1 and the previous value was below 1, and a sell position opens when it equals 0 and the previous value was above 0, detecting moments of trend direction transition. Exit conditions: positions close on reverse trend signals (BUY_Close or SELL_Close), with fixed stop loss and take profit in points. Position sizing supports five modes: free margin percentage, balance percentage, loss-free margin percentage, loss-balance percentage, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter for risk ratio and MMMode parameter for calculation basis. The EA only executes signal detection on new bar formation or when recalculation is needed, avoiding duplicate trades. The indicator uses XMA (extended moving average) double smoothing, with the first layer as EMA and the second as JJMA, enhancing trend determination reliability.

EA-16348.name: HelloSmart
EA-16348.summary: HelloSmart is a Martingale-style grid EA that opens positions at fixed price intervals (Step) and multiplies lot size by a Mnogitel factor when total position volume exceeds BigLot. It closes all positions when a profit target or loss limit is reached, then resets lot size to the initial value.
EA-16348.summary_zh: HelloSmart是一个马丁格尔风格的网格EA，按固定价格间隔开仓，当持仓总量超过BigLot时将手数乘以倍增系数。达到盈利目标或亏损限额时平掉所有仓位并重置手数。
EA-16348.strategy_analysis: 策略概念：该EA采用马丁格尔加仓策略，在价格每移动Step个点后加仓，试图通过增大仓位来摊薄成本并在回调时获利。入场条件：当BuySell=1时，若无持仓或当前Ask比上次开仓价格低Step个点，则买入；当BuySell=2时，若无持仓或当前Bid比上次开仓价格高Step个点，则卖出。出场条件：当累计浮动盈利超过Profit美元或亏损超过Loss美元时，平掉该品种所有仓位。仓位管理：初始使用Lot手数开仓，当累计持仓量达到BigLot时，手数乘以Mnogitel倍增系数，若手数超过MaxLots则重置为Lot。资金管理：仅通过Profit和Loss两个美元阈值控制盈亏，无止损止盈设置，且平仓后手数重置为初始值。该策略在单边行情中会持续加仓，风险极大。
EA-16348.strategy_analysis_en: Strategy concept: This EA employs a Martingale position-sizing approach, adding positions at fixed price intervals (Step points) and scaling up lot size to average down entry price, aiming to profit on price reversals. Entry conditions: When BuySell=1, it buys if there are no positions or if Ask has dropped Step points below the last entry price; when BuySell=2, it sells if there are no positions or if Bid has risen Step points above the last entry price. Exit conditions: All positions on the symbol are closed when cumulative floating profit exceeds Profit dollars or loss exceeds Loss dollars. Position sizing: Starts with Lot size, multiplies by Mnogitel when total volume reaches BigLot, and resets to Lot if the computed lot exceeds MaxLots. Money management: Relies solely on dollar-based profit/loss thresholds for closure, with no individual stop-loss or take-profit set on any position. The strategy continuously adds positions in trending markets, creating extreme drawdown risk.

EA-16359.name: Exp_AFL_WinnerV2
EA-16359.summary: This EA trades based on the AFL_WinnerV2 custom indicator, which produces color-based momentum signals (values 0-3). It opens buy positions when the indicator shifts to bullish momentum (value 3) and sell positions when it shifts to bearish momentum (value 0), with configurable signal confirmation and position closing logic. Position sizing uses a money management system with multiple modes including lot-based, balance percentage, and free margin percentage.
EA-16359.summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义指标AFL_WinnerV2进行交易，该指标产生基于颜色的动量信号（值0-3）。当指标转向看涨动量（值3）时开多仓，转向看跌动量（值0）时开空仓，具有可配置的信号确认和平仓逻辑。仓位管理支持多种模式，包括固定手数、余额百分比和可用保证金百分比。
EA-16359.strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是基于AFL_WinnerV2指标的动量跟踪策略。入场条件分为两类：第一类是当指标值变为3（看涨）且前一柱不为3时触发做多信号，第二类是当指标值变为0（看跌）且前一柱不为0时触发做空信号，这两类信号可分别通过BuyPosOpen1/2和SellPosOpen1/2开关独立控制。出场条件包括：当指标值大于1时关闭空头仓位，当指标值小于2时关闭多头仓位，同样可通过BuyPosClose和SellPosClose开关控制。仓位管理采用了五种模式：固定手数、基于余额百分比、基于可用保证金百分比、基于扣除亏损后的余额百分比以及基于扣除亏损后的可用保证金百分比。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例（默认0.1），止损设为1000点，止盈设为2000点，风险收益比为1:2。策略使用了新K柱检测机制避免重复信号，但缺乏滑点过滤和扩展点差过滤，在波动剧烈的市场中可能面临额外风险。
EA-16359.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a momentum-following approach based on the AFL_WinnerV2 indicator. Entry conditions are divided into two categories: the first triggers a buy signal when the indicator value becomes 3 (bullish) and the previous bar was not 3, and the second triggers a sell signal when the indicator value becomes 0 (bearish) and the previous bar was not 0, with both signal types independently controllable via BuyPosOpen1/2 and SellPosOpen1/2 switches. Exit conditions include closing short positions when the indicator value exceeds 1 and closing long positions when the indicator value falls below 2, also controllable via BuyPosClose and SellPosClose switches. Position sizing employs five modes: fixed lot, balance percentage, free margin percentage, balance minus loss percentage, and free margin minus loss percentage. Money management uses the MM parameter to control risk ratio (default 0.1), with stop loss set at 1000 points and take profit at 2000 points, yielding a risk-reward ratio of 1:2. The strategy implements a new bar detection mechanism to avoid repeated signals, but lacks slippage filtering and spread filtering, which may pose additional risks in highly volatile markets.

EA-16371.name: Exp_JSatl_Digit_System
EA-16371.summary: This EA implements a trend-following trading system based on the JSatl (Jurik Satl) digital filter indicator, which combines Jurik-style smoothing with adaptive trend-line analysis to identify and follow market trends. It generates buy and sell signals when the JSatl indicator changes direction or crosses threshold levels, opening positions in the direction of the detected trend. The system includes configurable stop-loss and take-profit parameters along with position sizing controls.
EA-16371.summary_zh: 该EA基于JSatl（Jurik Satl）数字滤波指标实现趋势跟踪交易系统，结合Jurik风格平滑与自适应趋势线分析来识别和跟随市场趋势。当JSatl指标改变方向或穿越阈值水平时，产生买入和卖出信号，沿检测到的趋势方向开仓。系统包含可配置的止损止盈参数及仓位管理控制。
EA-16371.strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于JSatl数字滤波指标，该指标融合了Jurik平滑算法与自适应趋势线技术，旨在过滤市场噪音并捕捉主趋势方向。入场条件依赖JSatl指标的方向变化——当指标由下降转为上升时产生买入信号，由上升转为下降时产生卖出信号，本质上是一种趋势反转跟踪策略。出场条件通过固定止损和止盈参数实现，当价格触及预设水平时自动平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数模式，允许用户通过参数设置每笔交易的手数大小。资金管理方面提供了最大持仓限制和保证金比例检查，但缺乏动态仓位调整机制如ATR-based仓位计算。整体策略逻辑清晰，但过于依赖单一指标的信号质量，在震荡市中可能频繁产生虚假信号。
EA-16371.strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the JSatl digital filter indicator, which integrates Jurik smoothing algorithms with adaptive trend-line technology to filter market noise and capture the main trend direction. Entry conditions rely on the JSatl indicator's directional changes—a buy signal is generated when the indicator turns from declining to rising, and a sell signal when it turns from rising to declining, essentially a trend-reversal tracking approach. Exit conditions are implemented through fixed stop-loss and take-profit parameters, automatically closing positions when price reaches preset levels. Position sizing uses a fixed lot mode, allowing users to set the lot size for each trade via input parameters. Money management provides maximum position limits and margin ratio checks, but lacks dynamic position sizing mechanisms such as ATR-based lot calculation. The overall strategy logic is clear, but it is overly dependent on the signal quality of a single indicator, which may frequently generate false signals in ranging markets.
